title: Dependency graph
description: Directed acyclic graphs drawn in layers: package dependencies, build pipelines, data lineage, task plans. The Sugiyama layout breaks cycles, assigns layers, routes long edges through dummy nodes, reduces crossings and keeps long edges straight; edges are smooth splines or orthogonal connectors with arrowheads. Hover or select a node to highlight everything upstream and downstream, and show the critical path of a plan.

overview.title: How the layout works
overview.text: DependencyGraph is GraphChart with layout="dag": boxes sized to their labels, arrows on every edge and lineage highlighting. The same layout is available as the pure function dagLayout.
overview.layers: Cycles are broken by reversing the back edges of a depth-first search, layers come from the longest path, then sources move next to their successors and nodes with balanced edges move to emptier layers.
overview.crossings: Edges spanning several layers get dummy nodes; barycenter and median sweeps then reorder every layer, keep the best order, and a transposition pass swaps neighbors while it removes crossings.
overview.coordinates: Positions within a layer come from a weighted isotonic regression towards the neighbors, with long edges weighted heavily so they stay straight. TB, LR, BT and RL directions are supported.
overview.highlight: highlight="lineage" (the default here) highlights all ancestors and descendants of the hovered, focused or selected nodes; criticalPath highlights the chain with the largest total duration (node value).

props.name: animation
props.description: Animates layout and data changes; a number is the duration in ms (default `true`)

props.name: deep
props.description:
Also follows in-place mutations of nested data (`series[0].data.push()`);
by default the chart updates when a prop is replaced (cheaper on large data)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend of the groups; shown by default with several groups

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it

props.name: interaction
props.description: Drag pans, Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel and pinch zoom, nodes can be dragged, click selects, arrow keys move; `false` makes the chart static (default `true`)

props.name: arrows
props.description: Arrowheads on the edges without `directed` (on for DAGs)

props.name: direction
props.description: Flow direction (default `TB`)

props.name: criticalPath
props.description: Highlights the longest path (node `value` = duration); `true` computes it, a list of ids sets it (default `false`)

props.name: nodeLabels
props.description: Node labels; `auto` hides minor and overlapping labels when zoomed out (default `auto`)

props.name: edgeLabels
props.description: Edge labels: always, `auto` (zoomed in or highlighted), only `hover`, or never (default `auto`)

props.name: controls
props.description: Zoom buttons (zoom in, zoom out, fit; default `true`)

props.name: groups
props.description: Groups: legend order, names and colors

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides of the built-in texts of the `locale`

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the nodes and edges: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D (default `auto`)

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels (default `100%`)

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels, strings any CSS length

props.name: palette
props.description: Group colors (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart

props.name: locale
props.description: Language of the built-in texts (summary, announcements, tooltip, buttons); the page language by default

props.name: highlight
props.description: What hovering / selecting a node highlights

props.name: nodes
props.description: The nodes (a new array re-runs the layout; an array rebuilt with the same node objects does not)

props.name: edges
props.description: The edges (parent → child in trees, prerequisite → dependent in DAGs)

props.name: dag
props.description: Layer / node spacing, crossing reduction sweeps

props.name: nodeShape
props.description: Shape of the nodes without `shape` (boxes for DAGs, org charts and mind maps, circles otherwise)

props.name: nodeSize
props.description: Circle diameter in layout units, or `[min, max]` scaled by the node `value`

props.name: edgeStyle
props.description: Edge shape; depends on the layout when omitted

props.name: edgeWidth
props.description: Edge width in CSS pixels, or `[min, max]` scaled by the edge `value`

props.name: edgeColor
props.description: Edge colors: neutral or tinted with the source / target node (default `neutral`)

props.name: arrowStyle
props.description: Shape of the arrowheads: `open` (a slim outlined head) or `filled` (a solid head in the edge color; default `open`)

props.name: selected
props.description: Ids of the selected nodes (changing it updates the selection)

props.name: fitPadding
props.description: Padding around the graph when fitting it, in CSS pixels (default 24)

packages.title: Package dependencies
packages.description: The packages of a monorepo, from the applications down to the tokens and the tooling. Dev dependencies are dashed; hover a package to see everything it depends on and everything that depends on it. utils and i18n depend on each other: a circular dependency, drawn in red as two separate routes.

pipeline.title: CI/CD pipeline
pipeline.description: A build pipeline from left to right with orthogonal connectors. Groups color the jobs by status (the legend can hide some), the node value is the duration, and criticalPath highlights the longest chain of jobs, computed again with criticalPath() for the summary. Two artifacts go from the app build to the package job (parallel edges get their own routes), and the failed visual tests retry themselves (a self-loop).

lineage.title: Upstream and downstream
lineage.description: Data lineage from the raw tables to the dashboards. The selection keeps the lineage highlighted: click a model to see what feeds it and what it feeds, Esc or a click on the background clears it.

build-scheduler.title: Build scheduler
build-scheduler.description: A task runner plays a monorepo build on 1, 2 or 4 workers, starting the ready task with the longest remaining chain first. Groups color the tasks done, running or queued as a timer advances, the node value is the duration and criticalPath shows the chain that bounds the build time however many workers there are.

project-plan.title: Project plan
project-plan.description: A website launch planned with the critical path method: earliest and latest start dates give the slack of every task, and the zero-slack chain is passed to criticalPath as a list of ids. Subtitles show workday ranges with Intl.DateTimeFormat.formatRange; click a task to read its dates and slack.

impact-analysis.title: Failure impact
impact-analysis.description: A nightly ETL run: pick the task that fails (or click a node) and everything downstream is marked blocked, with dashed incoming edges. highlight="lineage" with a controlled selected shows the blast radius, and the summary lists the outputs that will not be delivered.

course-prerequisites.title: Course prerequisites
course-prerequisites.description: A computer science curriculum grouped by year. The radio buttons switch direction between TB, LR, BT and RL, and the nodes move to their new layers; click a course to list every course to take before it, in catalogue order.

spreadsheet.title: Spreadsheet recalculation
spreadsheet.description: The formula cells of an order sheet and the cells they reference. Edit an input and the dependent cells are computed again: the edited cell is passed as selected so the lineage highlight shows exactly what was recalculated, and the subtitles format currencies and percentages with Intl.NumberFormat.

DependencyGraphProps.direction: Flow direction: TB (top to bottom), LR, BT or RL
DependencyGraphProps.dag: Layout settings: layer and node gaps, crossing reduction sweeps, critical path and its color
DependencyGraphProps.criticalPath: Highlights the longest path (node value = duration): true computes it, a list of node ids sets it

GraphDagOptions.layerGap: Space between two layers, in layout units
GraphDagOptions.nodeGap: Space between two nodes of a layer, in layout units
GraphDagOptions.sweeps: Number of down and up sweeps of the crossing reduction
GraphDagOptions.criticalPath: Highlights the longest path: true computes it from the node values, a list of node ids sets it
GraphDagOptions.criticalColor: Color of the critical path (any CSS color)

GraphCriticalPath.nodes: Node ids from the start to the end of the path
GraphCriticalPath.edges: Indices of the edges of the path
GraphCriticalPath.length: Sum of the node values along the path

GraphDagLayoutOptions.size: Width and height of each node in layout units; 24 × 24 when omitted

GraphDagLayoutResult.layer: Layer of each node, 0 being the first
GraphDagLayoutResult.order: Nodes of each layer in drawing order; dummy nodes of long edges are negative
GraphDagLayoutResult.routes: Waypoints of each edge from the source boundary to the target boundary (empty for ignored edges)
GraphDagLayoutResult.reversed: Indices of the edges reversed to break cycles
GraphDagLayoutResult.crossings: Edge crossings before and after the crossing reduction

pipeline.description: Jobs from left to right with orthogonal edges; the duration of a job is its value, so the longest chain of jobs is highlighted, and the switch turns it off.

modules.title: Module lineage
modules.description: Modules of a web application by layer; hovering or clicking a module highlights everything it needs and everything that needs it, and the selection is reported below.

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.nodes: Nodes { id, label, group, value… }; property only
props.edges: Edges { source, target, value, label… }; property only
props.groups: Groups { id, name, color }: legend order, names and colors; property only
props.nodeShape: Shape of the nodes without shape (boxes for DAGs, org charts and mind maps, circles otherwise)
props.edgeStyle: Edge shape; depends on the layout when omitted
props.edgeColor: Edge colors: neutral or tinted with the source / target node
props.arrowStyle: Shape of the arrowheads: open (a slim outlined head) or filled (a solid head in the edge color, following the theme and the highlight)
props.highlight: What hovering / selecting a node highlights
props.locale: Language of the built-in texts (summary, announcements, tooltip, buttons); the page language by default
props.selected: Ids of the selected nodes (changing it updates the selection); property only
props.options: Other engine options (GraphChartOptions: force, circular, dag, tree, nodeSize, edgeWidth, arrows, nodeLabels, edgeLabels, animation, legend, tooltip, interaction, renderer, palette, ariaLabel, labels…); property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) node / edge changed; detail: { type, id, node, edge, index, group, color, degree, clientX, clientY }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-item-click: A node or an edge was clicked (or a node activated with Enter); detail: { type, id, node, edge, index, group, color, degree, clientX, clientY }
events.minerva-toggle: A tree node was collapsed or expanded; detail: { id, collapsed }
events.minerva-group-toggle: The legend showed / hid a group; detail: { group, hidden }
events.minerva-layout-end: The layout is done (the force simulation cooled down); detail: { layout }
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.fit: Fits the visible nodes in the view
methods.focusNode: Centers a node (expanding its collapsed ancestors), optionally zooming
methods.setData: Replaces the data until the properties change again
methods.expand: Expands a node (all nodes without an id)
methods.collapse: Collapses a node (all nodes with children without an id)
methods.getPositions: Current positions of the nodes in layout units
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
